| description = One of the Triplets, along with [[Cekenar]] and [[Sevalak]].

Slowable. AE every ~18sec. Casts [[Diseased Cloud]]. (Not always 18 secs, sometimes 12 secs. Best to assume the 12 sec and not eat an AOE)

=== Strategy ===

Zlexak has low HP, but his AOE WILL wipe your party eventually, so it's all about DPS - Kill him before he kills you. 

Pull him so your casters can hide behind the corner of the wall. Good spot to pull to: directly north of the Ring of Vulak trigger mob and around the corner to the right.

Tanks get buffed and hit. Casters do the buffing and hide until an AE spell has been cast. Then jump out, cast once and run away. Repeat until dead or victorious...

Wizards: Sunstrike usually lands for less than 100 dmg, but Solist lands pretty reliably.
